chapter: A Gifted Rose: Long Day Ahead
act_title: A Gifted Rose: Long Day Ahead

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Long Day Ahead

dialogue.t: Ah, I haven't had time to cook yet, so I'm afraid I have nothing with which to receive you as guests.
So, this other kid is your friend, huh? She's pretty cute.
Do you want to come see the flowers when they bloom?
They will most likely bloom in a few days. Come back later to see the flowers you helped to plant.
Alright, I understand.
Come, come, look at these seeds.

dialogue.sit: Doesn't look like there's been any change.

dialogue.t: I've been growing crops for years, but growing flowers must be different.
Why else haven't they grown after so long?
Let Paimon see, hmm...
Grandpa Affan, Paimon thinks your nursery is too dry. And there might not be enough nutrients in the soil around Aaru Village.
We've helped a villager grow flowers before, so we have experience.
Huh. Is that so...
That makes sense. Such rare flowers should be more delicate than normal ones. Indeed, I don't water and fertilize them enough.
But this nursery is a little far from any water sources. It's not easy to bring water here.
And I don't store much water for daily use either, so it is rather inconvenient to water the seeds in the nursery often.
Alright, in that case, please water these three seeds first.
Water these three seeds first, and I'll think about what to do about the fertilizer.
After growing things for decades, I do know how to make some simple fertilizer.
Good, good, you two are very resourceful.
I have a feeling that they will grow well this time, now that I have guidance from the experts.
Were the Shawarma and Tahchin good?
Delicious, eh? I'll make more for you, then.
I'm not as good of a cook as my late wife, so forgive my poor cooking. Please take them. The portions are smaller this time, though.
This is so tasty! You're really kind! We'll visit you often.
Haha, didn't you children want to ask me what kind of flower this is?
I guess I might as well tell you. I'm planting roses.
This type of flower is called the Golden Rose. It's much more precious than the Sumeru Rose.
Remember how I told you that these flower seeds were left to me by a friend?
Well, these seeds, and this old house I'm living in now were all left to me by that late "old ghost."
Oh, I forgot. You're not from Aaru Village, so you're most likely not familiar with that name.
No matter. Just think of that fellow as an old man who used to grow some flowers...
Hey, Grandpa Affan, you're spacing out all of a sudden. Hello! Hello?
Ah! Oh. I was lost in thought. I'm sorry, I'm old, and my mind has begun to wander. How embarrassing...
Thank you again, children. You can have a look around if there's anything else you want to see.
I won't drive people away anymore. But be careful not to tread on the nursery.

quests.description: The flowers planted by Affan haven’t sprouted yet. Water them for him.
